mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium), which can potentiate tetrabenazine's CNS effects and increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias and neurotoxicity.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially K+ and Mg2+), and neurological status closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure aggressive electrolyte repletion during concurrent use.
